doc: One shrub to grow: what the game asks for ("an old holly in winter, berries on"), plus the seed that makes it differ from its neighbours and the level of detail the runtime picked.

fields.name: fruit
fields.doc: The shrub carries its berries, in the seasons its species fruits. The game clears it when they are picked, which rebuilds it bare (sharing the build with every other picked shrub like it).

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Stable randomness: the runtime maps each shrub's ID onto a capped set of seeds per quality level.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Level of detail, chosen by the runtime from distance and quality.
